name: pool1
note: the snow-covered EAST FLANK of the barrow mound: deep snow over the mound's earth, its rounded slope shown by soft blue-violet shading, many separate clumps of reddish-brown winter heather with snow between them (where the olive patches are), and the low darker curving ridge of the mound's front lobe running down to the bottom edge exactly where the render puts it. NO pool, pond, ice, water or stream anywhere in it -- it is all snowy mound slope and heather. No stones, no new objects.
